title: Home page composition
subtitle: Every storefront block is configured here, in the current language. Hidden blocks are not rendered.
structureInRef: Block structure is set in {locale}. Here you only change the texts.
confirmReset: Restore this block to its default settings for this language? Saved texts will be lost.
orderHint: Drag a row (or use the arrows) to change the order blocks appear in.
noBlockSelected: Pick a block on the left to configure it.
textsFallbackHint: An empty field falls back to the site translation, so a page can never end up without text.
customCssHint: The CSS is scoped to this block (an ancestor selector is added automatically); it cannot affect the rest of the page.
builderHint: “Built page” mode replaces the block content with the HTML produced by the page builder. Block styling (background, height) still applies.
builderSafety: Scripts, event handlers (onclick…) and embedded frames are stripped on save: the HTML is rendered without executing code.
autoHint: The site takes the first {count} cards of the module, using the configured sort.
manualHint: {count} card(s) selected, in the order you arranged them.
autoPreview: No forced card: the first {count} will be shown.
nothingSelected: No card selected yet — add some with the button.
selectionOverLimit: Only the first {shown} selected cards are shown ({selected} selected).
emptyList: Empty list — the block uses its default values.
textsOnlyNote: Only the texts can be edited here.
structureInRefShort: Setting shared by the three languages
copySubtitle: A block’s content (texts, item count, selected cards) is copied into the chosen languages.
copyNote: Structure (block order, number shown, selected cards, appearance) is shared by the three languages and can only be changed in French.
importAction: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing to take over} one {Take over this block} other {Take over site data (#)}}
importHint: Copies the content already published — catalogue records, figures from the configuration file, translated labels — into the block's saved configuration. Anything the back-office has already saved is never overwritten.
importNone: No block is currently reading its content from the site's files.
confirmImport: {count, plural, one {Take over the site content into this block? It will be written into the configuration and become editable.} other {Take over the site content into the # affected blocks? It will be written into the configuration and become editable.}}
importDone: {count, plural, one {# block taken over.} other {# blocks taken over.}}
importBanner: This block currently shows content read from the site's files: nothing has been saved here yet. Saving the block freezes that content; “Take over” writes it into the configuration, where you can edit or remove it.
freeOnlySource: The band is set to “Studio blocks only”: it uses no module records, only the blocks written below.
